name: Humanitas
source:
You are a woman forced to flee your humble village after the invasion of the Brotherhood of Retribution, a violent group taking over your world in the name of their god. With the help of friends you meet along the way, you discover that it is up to you to save your world. 

But the truth behind these dark times is deeper and more menacing than you ever imagined. The only way to prevail is to confront the truth about your world, about yourself, and about humanity.

Will you succeed? Will you die trying? In the end, can your world truly be saved?

[From [url=https://no-fate-productions.itch.io/humanitas]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名在报应兄弟会入侵后被迫逃离简陋村庄的女人，报应兄弟会是一个暴力组织，以他们的神的名义占领了你的世界。在一路上遇到的朋友的帮助下，你发现拯救世界的重任落在了你的肩上。

但这些黑暗时代背后的真相比你想象的更深刻、更危险。获胜的唯一方法就是面对关于你的世界、你自己和人类的真相。

你会成功吗？你会尝试死去吗？最终，你的世界真的能被拯救吗？

[来自[url=https://no-fate-productions.itch.io/humanitas]Itch.io[/url]]
